note: Rules for PRD-governed values on the marketing site (skills/drawlogic-prototype-fidelity/SKILL.md, precedence). The prices themselves are read from docs/PRD.md §10 at run time (lib/prd.mjs): US-dollar amounts from the plan table's Price column, naira amounts from the 'Nigeria tier prices' table. This file holds only the checks, their citations, and amounts the PRD does not state. Values tied to an OPEN decision are reported, never asserted.

forbidden_anywhere.what: Practice seat count from the prototype

comparison_table.note: Cells of the prototype's 'Line by line' comparison table that the PRD states. Columns are found by tier name in the table header.

usd_allowed.note: Every US-dollar amount on the site must be a PRD §10 plan price (read from the PRD), or one of these prototype amounts the PRD does not state, which are reported until decided.

prd_silent.status: not in PRD; prototype value stands until decided

ngn.note: With NGN chosen in any currency toggle, every displayed price must be in PRD §10 'Nigeria tier prices' (read from the PRD; ₦0 covers Free and Student), or one of these amounts the PRD does not state, which are reported until decided.

prd_silent.status: not in PRD §10; reported until the larger packs are decided

behaviour_overrides.reason: PRD §10 Nigeria tier (Decision 12; DESIGN_GAPS row 20 closed): the toggle switches between the PRD §10 naira prices and USD prices; the export's toggle is inert. Checked by prd.spec.ts instead of the recorded prototype behaviour.

open_decisions.what: Idea tier USD price point ($14/mo vs $29/project)
